title: Every animation kept with its preview and its source, outside git
summary: Every animation file the installation has been given is kept outside git, in collection/ on the first computer and its copy on the share, as its ODRG file with its preview GIF and a readme of its source beside it, built by hand on 2026-10-27, while only the previews are tracked in thumbnails/; the seed makes .gitignore ignore the folder in every clone, adds --beside to the converter's thumbnail subcommand, and corrects the pages for the owner's answers, the repository being public.
